description.value:
You draw upon the collective's memory of wildshaping to reshape your jaw and canine teeth into the powerful fangs of a great predator. You grow a fangs unarmed Strike that deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the grapple, magical, and unarmed traits. You are trained with this attack, and if your weapon proficiency with martial weapons is higher than your unarmed proficiency, your fangs use that proficiency instead. The fangs count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances.

Heightened (3rd) The fangs' damage die increases to 1d8.

Heightened (5th) The fangs' damage increases to 2d6, and a critical hit with them allows you to attempt to Grapple the target as a free action.

Heightened (7th) The fangs' damage increases to 2d8.

Heightened (9th) The fangs' damage increases to 3d8 and gain the deadly d10 trait.
